metadata.description: Protection and regulatory zones for the Fathom study area. Polygons are HAND-DRAWN APPROXIMATIONS of official NOAA/BOEM areas (not the official shapefiles); dates and speed limits are verified against the cited NOAA sources. Each zone links its official source.
metadata.source: Hand-drawn approximations of NOAA Fisheries SMAs, Mass DMF/GARFO closures, and BOEM wind lease areas
metadata.license: Underlying facts are U.S. Government work / public domain (NOAA, BOEM); the approximate polygons here are our own.
metadata.note: Speed limits apply by law to vessels 65 ft and longer; Fathom treats them as advisory for all vessels.

zones.name: Cape Cod Bay Seasonal Management Area
zones.note: Hand-drawn approximation of the NOAA Cape Cod Bay SMA. Dates verified: active Jan 1 through May 15; 10 kn for vessels >=65 ft.

zones.name: Off Race Point Seasonal Management Area
zones.note: Hand-drawn approximation of the NOAA Off Race Point SMA. Dates verified: active Mar 1 through Apr 30; 10 kn for vessels >=65 ft.

zones.name: Great South Channel Seasonal Management Area
zones.note: Hand-drawn approximation of the NOAA Great South Channel SMA (only its western edge falls in the study bbox). Dates verified: active Apr 1 through Jul 31; 10 kn for vessels >=65 ft.

zones.name: Dynamic Slow Zone - Stellwagen (example)
zones.note: Illustrative Dynamic/Voluntary Slow Zone. Real DSZs are triggered by sightings and change frequently; this is an example window, not a live DSZ. Check the NOAA DSZ page for current zones.

zones.name: Western Gulf of Maine Seasonal Closure
zones.note: Hand-drawn approximation of a seasonal fishery closure in the western Gulf of Maine. Confirm exact boundary/dates on the NOAA GARFO closures page before operational use.

zones.name: Vineyard Wind Lease Area (OCS-A 0501)
zones.note: Hand-drawn approximation of a BOEM Massachusetts/Rhode Island wind energy lease area. Not the official BOEM lease polygon.

zones.name: Vineyard Wind Construction Exclusion (example window)
zones.note: Illustrative construction-exclusion window inside the lease area; not an official BOEM construction notice.
